title: ROCKBROS Pegasus / PGZ road-bike family
notes: The official family page identifies Pegasus as the PGZ road-bike series and lists materially different PGZ 1.0, PGZ 2.0, PGZ 4.0 and R8020 builds. The exact PGZ 1.0 page specifies a full-carbon Toray T700/T800-reinforced frame, Shimano 105 R7120 2x12 build, 8.55 kg in size M and 28 mm maximum clearance, while other named builds differ. None of those build-specific values is transferred to the retained generic Pegasus seller card.
